summary: CSV format: CsvSpec options (delimiter, quoting, escape, null sequence, multi-row headers, comments, column and dtype selection, temporal handling, formula neutralisation), plus a parser that uses native pyarrow when the input allows and a lexer otherwise, a prefix-bounded schema inspector and a serialiser.
lifecycle_notes: The native pyarrow path requires single-character ASCII tokens, no comments, contiguous header rows, safe line breaks and balanced quotes; any other input is lexed in Python and re-encoded as canonical CSV.
With formula_neutralise, the serialiser prefixes cells that start with a formula character (OWASP CSV injection). This is lossy and parsing does not reverse it.
risks: _resolve_type supports only six dtype names and silently maps any other name to string.
open_questions: Should an unknown dtype name in CsvSpec.dtypes raise instead of falling back to string?
